description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Sales" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approved"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales and Customer Support" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_Approval" name="Quote approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved" messageRef="Msg_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_Confirmation" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and Order Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant information"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns or questions"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Process ended without order"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Guide selection of product or service"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproved" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_Approval" messageRef="Msg_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
